sources.title: Historical Geographic Information Systems (GIS) database of U.S. Railroads, 1826–1911 (revised 31 October 2023)
sources.access: Archive and embedded XML inspected 2026-11-15. XML permits free use with attribution. ExactDate is used where nonzero; otherwise InOpBy. Four later bridge/segment attestations in the archive (1912/1916) are retained. Names are generally historical pre-1861 operators, not a complete later company register.

provenance.meaning: Accumulated built/attested historical infrastructure. No service end or continuous operation is inferred. Source reconstruction combines historic map chronology, historic USGS maps and surviving alignments; this is not an unfiltered modern network.
provenance.limitations: Lower 48 coverage. Most dates are map attestations; some bridges are dated separately or assumed contemporary with connecting track. Source omits most sidings and yards and may contain network gaps. No construction animation between attestations.
